description: Stores candidate resumes parsed from Telegram uploads, indexed by Telegram chat ID.

columns.name: chat_id
columns.description: Telegram user chat ID (used as unique match key for upserting and retrieving user CV)

columns.name: file_name
columns.description: Original PDF filename uploaded by the user (default: cv.pdf)

columns.name: cv_text
columns.description: Extracted text representation from the candidate's CV (capped at 30,000 characters)

columns.name: uploaded_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the CV was uploaded or updated (format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm)
